questions.q: According to the summary, which three kinds of work does a developer do?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a developer maps goals, makes the actual work, and meshes skills to keep growing.

questions.q: Which type of person does the making and meshing but skips the mapping?
questions.why: Lesson 1 defines the drifter as someone who does the making and meshing but omits mapping.

questions.q: What imagination exercise does the summary suggest for escaping mediocrity?
a: Imagine someone records your day and writes your biography
Picture your own funeral and what people would say
Write a letter from your future self about today
Spend a day living as your childhood hero
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes imagining that every action you take today will become a biography others read.

questions.q: Which of the three goal types is described as medium-term, usually around two weeks?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says step goals are daily, sprint goals last about two weeks, and stretch goals are long-term.

questions.q: What does the summary call the single worst enemy of excellence?
questions.why: Lesson 2 names mediocrity as excellence's worst enemy because it keeps people comfortably stuck.
